aiwatcher-local.label: AIWatcher Local
aiwatcher-local.review_prompt: Check local scenario status, product scope, and whether the OSS change should propagate to Enterprise.

enterprise.label: AIWatcher Enterprise
enterprise.review_prompt: Check enterprise scenario status, implementation/spec alignment, and OSS-to-enterprise propagation links.
enterprise.platform_guidance: Do not claim enterprise, local, SDK, billing, SIEM, or FinOps coverage until the matching integration is verified. Enterprise docs may reference private roadmap details here because this repository stays private.

extra_review_sections.use: How OSS scenarios should propagate, adapt, or stay separate.

implementation_order: Build the enterprise scenario-doc automation and keep this folder as the private source of truth.
Reconcile Enterprise navigation around Inbox, Controls, Work Ledger, Evidence, Reports, and Settings.
Pull OSS Local concepts into Enterprise using the propagation matrix.
Build Enterprise Usage Rules as the first enterprise-only control feature.
Add runtime SDK policy evaluation, evidence receipts, and protected-spend reports.
